demux_video_from_file: demux video packets from a media file using Demuxer and demux_video with optional time window
decode_video_packets: decode video packets into frames using Decoder or decode_packets with optional filter graph
encode_image_to_file: encode a numpy array or tensor as an image file using encode_image with pixel format config
transfer_buffer_to_gpu: transfer a CPU buffer to a CUDA device using transfer_buffer with a CUDA device config
mux_audio_video_streams: mux audio and video streams into an output file using Muxer with add_encode_stream and write
